text:
jordan_billing: Flagging an oddity on NexTier Labs (partner rebate)  looks like Q1 partner rebate was applied twice to their March invoice. Net over-credit ~ $18,750. Need direction on write-back vs goodwill.

maria_ops: Can you paste the invoice excerpt so AR can validate?

jordan_billing: Redacted excerpt below:

```
INV-2026-0318 - NexTier Labs
PO: PO-80122
Line 8: Q1 Partner Rebate - Credit -$18,750
Line 9: Q1 Partner Rebate (duplicate) - Credit -$18,750
Invoice total before credits: $64,300
Credits applied: -$37,500
Amount due: $26,800 (should have been $45,550)
Discrepancy: $18,750 over-credit
```

eli_engineer: We deployed a partner-rebate ingestion fix on 2026-03-15 that prevented replayed rebate messages. Root cause: webhook retries created duplicate audit IDs in the rebate service for a short window. Linked internal ticket AT-2026-2250.

priya_accounts: AR confirmed the credits hit customer ledger today. If we reverse it, customer will see an invoice change. Do we want to attempt recovery from NexTier or treat as goodwill?

liam_sales: NexTier is a strategic partner; we committed to a $75k total FY rebate, but not double-crediting. I suggest we ask NexTier to issue a correcting invoice or refund. If they refuse, we can consider booking the $18,750 as a contra-revenue adjustment (goodwill) for this quarter, but need finance sign-off.

jordan_billing: Draft vendor credit request to NexTier: "Our system recorded a duplicate partner-rebate entry on INV-2026-0318 totalling $18,750. Requesting either a refund or issuing a correcting debit note so we can reconcile our AR ledger." Want me to send?

priya_accounts: Before sending, we need GL guidance. Alex had suggested last quarter to use GL 5402-REB for partner rebates, and 5901-EXC for exception/write-offs. Which should apply if vendor refuses to correct?

maria_ops: Tagging finance; alex_fin is OOO but we need interim approval from me + CFO. I propose: if vendor issues refund or debit note, post to 5402-REB. If vendor refuses and we absorb, post to 5901-EXC with memo code PRB-2026-0318.

billing-bot: Created audit ticket AT-2026-2250, created adjustment draft ADJ-2026-112, status: pending-vendor-response.

liam_sales: Also ask NexTier for timeline if they opt to refund. We need to know for cash forecasting.

jordan_billing: Sending vendor note requesting refund or correcting invoice and asking for expected timeline. CC-ing priya_accounts and maria_ops. Will update when vendor replies.

priya_accounts: Approving the proposed GL flow. If NexTier issues a debit note, AR to apply and close ADJ-2026-112. If no vendor remediation in 30 days, escalate to CFO for write-off approval.

maria_ops: Agreed. Adding internal audit requirement: include the webhook retry log snapshot and timestamp window in AT-2026-2250.
